title: A method for the process of collagen modified polyester from fish scales waste
author: Hou, Huang, et al.

steps.title: Wash fish scales
steps.instruction: Rinse the fish scales thoroughly with purified water.

steps.title: Dry fish scales
steps.instruction: Dry the washed fish scales using cooling fans.

steps.title: Freeze‑dry scales
steps.instruction: Place the dried fish scales in a cold drying chamber and perform quick freeze under vacuum conditions.

steps.title: Micronize scales
steps.instruction: Grind the frozen fish scales into fine particles using a mechanical crusher.

steps.title: Enzyme hydrolysis
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate enzyme to the finely crushed fish scale material and incubate the mixture in warm water to allow enzymatic treatment.

steps.title: Filtration and drying
steps.instruction: Centrifugally filter the hydrolyzed liquid and then dry the filtrate to obtain a collagen peptide powder.
